sloka: ततः कांचन शैल आभः ताराया वीर्यवान् पिता ।अनेकैः बहु साहस्रैः कोटिभिः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥४-३९-१५॥
transliteration: tataḥ kāṁcana śaila ābhaḥ tārāyā vīryavān pitā ।anekaiḥ bahu sāhasraiḥ koṭibhiḥ pratyadṛśyata ॥4-39-15॥

translations.english: (Next came) the valiant father of Tara of golden complexion like mount Meru followed by ten thousand crore of vanaras.
